summary: The afternoon has brought no relief. The Sensex is still down about 900–1,000 points and banks are dragging hardest, with the Nifty stuck around 22,825 and every sector red.

detail.tone: Flat from 13:00: the Nifty was 22,825.25 (−1.36%) at 1 pm and there is no afternoon bounce yet. Bank heavyweights (HDFC Bank, ICICI, SBI) are now the main drag.
watch: Whether banks stabilise into the last 90 minutes
